Ingredients: with raisins, cinnamon, ginger, carrot, apple, coconut, walnuts, vanilla & eggs
Reheat Instructions: Place on a baking sheet and warm at 325 degrees F for 8-10 minutes. Enjoy warm or at room temperature. Store in an airtight container at room temperature up to 3 days or refrigerate up to 1 week. (1 dozen.)

Ingredients: with yogurt, milk, chia seeds, maple syrup, vanilla & fresh blueberries
Reheat Instructions: Best served cold straight from the refrigerator. Give it a good stir before eating. Keep refrigerated and enjoy within 4-5 days. (1 dozen servings.)

Ingredients: with flour, sugar, butter, cream, vanilla, eggs & cinnamon
Reheat Instructions: Place on a baking sheet and warm at 325 degrees F for 8-10 minutes. Enjoy warm. Store in an airtight container at room temperature up to 2 days or refrigerate up to 5 days. (1 dozen.)

Ingredients: with turkey sausage, onions, peppers & cheese
Reheat Instructions: Place on a baking sheet at 325 degrees F for 8-10 minutes until heated through. Keep refrigerated and enjoy within 4-5 days. Freeze up to 1 month. (1 dozen.)

Ingredients: with chickpeas, lemon, tahini, garlic, basil, parmesan & olive oil
Reheat Instructions: Best served at room temperature. Remove from the fridge 15 minutes before serving. Keep refrigerated and enjoy within 5-7 days. (1 batch.)

Ingredients: with chipotle peppers, chickpeas, garlic, lemon & tahini
Reheat Instructions: Best served at room temperature. Remove from the fridge 15 minutes before serving. Keep refrigerated and enjoy within 5-7 days. (1 batch.)

Ingredients: with carrots, celery, onion & potatoes
Reheat Instructions: Warm on the stovetop over medium-low heat for 10-12 minutes, stirring occasionally, until heated through. Keep refrigerated and enjoy within 4-5 days. Freezes well up to 3 months. (6-8 servings.)

Ingredients: with carrots, celery, onion, thyme & egg noodles
Reheat Instructions: Warm on the stovetop over medium-low heat for 8-10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until heated through. Noodles will absorb liquid over time - add a splash of chicken broth if needed. Keep refrigerated and enjoy within 4-5 days. (6-8 servings.)

Ingredients: served with steamed green beans
Reheat Instructions: Meatloaf: Reheat covered with foil at 325 degrees F for 15-18 minutes. Mashed Potatoes: Reheat in an oven-safe dish covered with foil at 325 degrees F for 15 minutes. Green Beans: Reheat on a baking sheet at 375 degrees F for 5-7 minutes. Best enjoyed within 3-4 days.

Ingredients: served with steamed green beans
Reheat Instructions: Schnitzel: Reheat on a foil-lined baking sheet at 375 degrees F for 10-12 minutes, flipping halfway, until heated through and edges are crisp. Potatoes: Reheat on a baking sheet at 375 degrees F for 8-10 minutes. Green Beans: Reheat on a baking sheet at 375 degrees F for 5-7 minutes. Best enjoyed within 3-4 days.

Ingredients: served with steamed green beans
Reheat Instructions: Chili: Warm on the stovetop over medium-low heat for 8-10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Green Beans: Reheat on a baking sheet at 375 degrees F for 5-7 minutes. Keep refrigerated up to 5 days. Freezes well up to 3 months.

Ingredients: served with steamed green beans
Reheat Instructions: Quesadillas: Reheat on a foil-lined baking sheet at 375 degrees F for 8-10 minutes, flipping halfway, until cheese is melted and tortilla is crisp. Green Beans: Reheat on a baking sheet at 375 degrees F for 5-7 minutes. Best enjoyed within 3-4 days.

Ingredients: with lamb meatballs, pickled red onion, sliced cucumbers, cherry tomatoes, tzatziki & pita bread
Reheat Instructions: Meatballs: Reheat on a foil-lined baking sheet covered with foil at 325 degrees F for 12-15 minutes. Pita: Warm wrapped in foil at 325 degrees F for 5 minutes. Serve pickled onion, cucumbers, tomatoes & tzatziki cold alongside. Best enjoyed within 3-4 days.

Ingredients: with ginger sauce & broccoli over sushi rice
Reheat Instructions: Salmon: Reheat on a foil-lined baking sheet at 275 degrees F for 12-15 minutes. Rice: Reheat in an oven-safe dish covered with foil at 325 degrees F for 10-12 minutes. Broccoli: Reheat on a baking sheet at 375 degrees F for 5-7 minutes. Drizzle ginger sauce after reheating. Best enjoyed within 3 days.

Ingredients: with dried cranberries, sweet & salty pecan pumpkin crunch & maple apple cider vinaigrette
Reheat Instructions: Best served at room temperature or chilled. Remove from the fridge 10 minutes before serving. Dress with the maple apple cider vinaigrette just before serving. Keep refrigerated and enjoy within 3-4 days. Store dressing separately.

Ingredients: with bacon, hard boiled eggs, cherry tomatoes, red onion, avocado & red wine vinaigrette
Reheat Instructions: Serve chilled straight from the refrigerator. Dress with the red wine vinaigrette just before serving. If avocado is included, best enjoyed within 1-2 days. Keep refrigerated and enjoy within 3 days. Store dressing separately.

Ingredients: with spinach & mushrooms in a creamy sauce over jasmine rice with garlicky broccolini
Reheat Instructions: Salmon: Reheat on a foil-lined baking sheet at 275 degrees F for 12-15 minutes. Rice: Reheat in an oven-safe dish covered with foil at 325 degrees F for 10-12 minutes. Creamy sauce & spinach/mushrooms: Reheat in an oven-safe dish covered with foil at 325 degrees F for 10-12 minutes. Broccolini: Reheat on a baking sheet at 375 degrees F for 5-7 minutes. Best enjoyed within 3 days.

Ingredients: with a garlicky lemon butter sauce & asparagus
Reheat Instructions: Shrimp & orzo: Reheat in an oven-safe dish covered with foil at 325 degrees F for 10-12 minutes, adding a small splash of water or broth before covering to keep orzo moist. Asparagus: Reheat on a baking sheet at 375 degrees F for 5-7 minutes. Best enjoyed within 3 days.

Ingredients: with Italian sausage, sun dried tomatoes & spinach
Reheat Instructions: Reheat in an oven-safe dish covered with foil at 325 degrees F for 15-18 minutes. Add a splash of water or broth before covering to loosen the sauce. Best enjoyed within 3-4 days.

Ingredients: with yellow rice & peas
Reheat Instructions: Barbacoa: Reheat in an oven-safe dish covered with foil at 325 degrees F for 15-18 minutes, adding a splash of its braising liquid before covering. Rice & peas: Reheat in a separate oven-safe dish covered with foil at 325 degrees F for 10-12 minutes. Best enjoyed within 3-4 days. Barbacoa freezes well up to 3 months.
